title: Add regression tests for hari_kerja strict behavior
description: Add 2+ bun:test cases covering the bug scenario: (1) hari_kerja=0 + kehadiran>0 → jabatanAmount=0; (2) hari_kerja<kehadiran → uses hari_kerja not kehadiran as multiplier; (3) null/undefined hari_kerja → treated as 0. These guard against future regression of the fallback.

files.target: describe block, append new it() cases
files.change: Add 3 new test cases that exercise the strict hari_kerja behavior. Use existing test pattern (import payrollAutoBufferService, call calculateAutomaticValues, assert result fields).

implementation: Add test: 'returns jabatanAmount=0 when hariKerja=0 even if kehadiran>0' — input {jabatanText:'mandor panen', hariKerja:0, kehadiran:25, dbJabatanJumlah:0, dbMasaKerjaJumlah:0}, expect jabatanAmount=0, jabatanRate=0, jabatanUsedFallback=false

Add test: 'multiplies by hariKerja strictly (not kehadiran) when both differ' — input {jabatanText:'operator', hariKerja:15, kehadiran:25, dbJabatanJumlah:0, dbMasaKerjaJumlah:0}, expect jabatanAmount=3500*15=52500, jabatanRate=3500

Add test: 'treats null/undefined hariKerja as 0 (no NaN, no fallback to kehadiran)' — input {jabatanText:'helper', hariKerja:null, kehadiran:20, dbJabatanJumlah:0, dbMasaKerjaJumlah:0}, expect jabatanAmount=0, jabatanRate=0
Run `cd backend && bun test src/services/payroll/payrollAutoBufferService.test.ts` and verify all tests (existing 6 + new 3) pass

reference.pattern: bun:test describe/it pattern with expect assertions; mirror existing test style
reference.examples: Follow lines 4-107 of existing test file for assertion style and input shape

criteria: At least 3 new test cases added covering: zero hariKerja with positive kehadiran, hariKerja<kehadiran, null hariKerja
All new tests pass under `bun test`
All 6 existing tests still pass (no regression)
Test names clearly describe the strict-hariKerja behavior (regression-proof naming)

rationale.chosen_approach: Append 3 regression tests in the existing describe block using same style as existing tests
alternatives_considered: Add a single parameterized test (rejected: bun:test has limited parametrization, readability worse)
Add a separate test file (rejected: existing test file is the natural home for service-level tests)
Skip tests and rely on manual verification (rejected: user explicitly required test coverage in fix)
decision_factors: Existing tests use hariKerja===kehadiran so they pass regardless of fallback — new tests fill that coverage gap
Bun:test is the project's test runner per existing test file
Tests are colocated with the service they validate
rationale.tradeoffs: Adds 3 small test cases that take ~5 min to write but prevent future regression of this exact bug class.
